capabilities: Analyze the current note with an LLM in a streaming sidebar panel
Run selectable perspectives (outline, key concepts, distill) in parallel result tabs
Edit each perspective's system prompt and add custom ones
Export tab results as Markdown notes or Canvas files
Persist analysis per note and restore it when switching back
extras: Privacy note: the full text of the current note, including unsaved edits, is sent over HTTPS to the configured provider; very long notes are split into multiple billed calls. Interface language follows Obsidian's display language (English/中文).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get an AI-generated outline, concept explanations, or summary of the note you are reading in a side panel.

relations.evidence: Works with Claude (Anthropic) and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including local Ollama and third-party proxies).
